CorpusProcessor.process_file.doc: Process a single text file and record all its words to the lexicon.

params.language: language tag recorded with the words; None to leave untagged
params.skip_seen: skip a file already recorded in the lexicon

CorpusProcessor.process_directory.doc: Process all matching files in a directory, saving the lexicon after each file.

params.pattern: glob pattern of files to process
params.skip_seen: skip files already recorded in the lexicon

CorpusProcessor.process_directory.returns: aggregate statistics over the files processed

params.paths: the same content in several languages; the first file provides the passage structure and domain descriptions

CorpusProcessor.stats.doc: Return counters for the current processor.
CorpusProcessor.stats.returns: files, passages and words processed, plus the lexicon statistics
